product.title: Grand Teton and National Elk Refuge Winter Wonderland Full Day Adventure

description.text: There's a special beauty to Grand Teton National Park in the snowy silence of winter, free of the summertime crowds. On this Grand Teton day trip from Jackson Hole, a guide helps you search for bison and bighorn sheep, and you could also see moose, coyotes, eagles, or even wolves. Stops include National Elk Refuge, Grand Teton, Jackson. In addition, visit the National Elk Refuge, where you ride past herds of powerful elk on a comfortable, horse-drawn sleigh.Drive deep into Grand Teton National Park to view wildlife Bundle up for a fun ride on a horse-drawn sleigh in the National Elk Refuge Learn about the Wyoming wilderness from your guide Snap grea Ideal for travelers basing in Jackson Hole who want a guided Wyoming outing without self-driving mountain roads.
